'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Jeremy Gardner LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Gardner]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)|VB5-L-wellhandlethis-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' More Trash
* '''Username:''' JediJer
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
